notes.title: Alchemists Update: Keypad Doors Added!
notes.content:
📢 Alchemists Update: Keypad Doors Added! 🔐

Fellow Alchemists, are you ready for a new challenge? We’ve just added Keypad-locked doors to the game! Now, you’ll need to find the correct codes to unlock certain doors and progress further.

🔎 Where are the codes?
The codes are hidden on the same floor as the locked doors. Explore your surroundings carefully, search for clues, and piece together the numbers to unlock your path.

🗝️ New Mechanics = More Mystery!
With this update, the game’s exploration and puzzle-solving elements get even deeper. The codes could be carved into walls, scribbled on objects, or hidden within cryptic notes—pay attention to every detail!

💀 Be careful… You’re not alone!
As you search for the codes, remember: dark entities are always watching. The faster you move, the safer you might be… or maybe not?

Jump into the game now and experience this new mechanic! Let us know what you think.

🔮 The Alchemists Team

notes.title: Release
notes.content:
Alchemists! We are waiting for approval from Steam and will release our game as soon as possible. Our early access game will be available to you very soon.

In *Alchemists*, players will join forces to complete four dangerous elemental rituals. Each ritual requires finding hidden ritual pieces in terrifying environments. However, the deeper you delve, the more you will realize you are not alone. A terrifying monster hunts your every move, ready to strike when you least expect it.

**Key Features:**
- Multiple thematic maps to explore
- Special gadgets to survive: UV lights, Camera, Radar, medkits, and more
- Dynamic difficulty – enemies become more dangerous as you progress
- Team-based gameplay – rescue captured friends and survive the nightmare together
- Community-driven development – your feedback shapes the game

As you work with your team to complete the rituals, remember that survival is not guaranteed. The more progress you make, the more aggressive the monster becomes, evolving with your every move. Your team must work together to stay alive because any mistake could be your last.

**Game Story:**
*Alchemists* brings together alchemy and dark magic in a gripping tale. Players, either solo or in groups of up to four, must solve puzzles and complete four elemental rituals while escaping from a terrifying monster. As players gather ritual pieces scattered throughout each environment, they are tasked with using special tools to survive. Once the four rituals are complete, the monster is destroyed. However, if a player is captured, their teammates must use a medkit to save them. The game’s atmosphere is enhanced by jumpscares and tense audio, making each moment increasingly terrifying. With continuous updates, new maps and monsters will be introduced to keep the experience fresh.

**Maps:**
The first map, *Trasmoz*, is set in a chilling environment filled with a church, carpenter’s workshop, mansion, barn, cemetery, water tower, artificial lake, dungeon, tunnels, ancient ruins, haylofts, and forested areas. The map offers a variety of locations where players must complete rituals and gather ritual pieces. Future maps will feature new challenges, monsters, and puzzles.

**Talisman Glasses:**
One of the key items in the game is the *Talisman Glasses*. When players find these glasses, only the player who finds them can see the ritual clues, guiding their teammates to collect the pieces necessary for completing the rituals. This adds a layer of strategy, as the team must rely on the individual who has the glasses to lead them through the ritual.

**Upcoming Features:**

- **Fourth Map and Voice Interaction:
** The fourth map, voice interaction, and new monsters will be added one month after launch.
- **New Monsters:** New monsters will be introduced in all maps, with different types and abilities to keep players on their toes.

"We are working hard to make our game even better. Thank you in advance for your support!"

Alchemists Team
